teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.

work.note: A referência é a feira em que Charlotte e Wilbur competem. Charlotte's Web é um livro infantil de E. items.wrong: When the curtain was opening, he sang.
items.fix: When the curtain opened, he was singing.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: I was eat popcorn. → I was eating popcorn. | They was laughing. → They were laughing. | When the curtain was opening, he sang. → When the curtain opened, he was singing..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

errors.w: When the curtain was opening, he sang.
errors.r: When the curtain opened, he was singing.

facts.label: Passado em progresso
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para a ação curta: I was eating popcorn when the lights went out.

facts.label: Estava fazendo
facts.sub: Para uma ação em progresso no passado, use was ou were + verbo com -ing: A man was singing. We were walking home. Use was com I, he, she, it e were com you, we, they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para ligar a ação curta à ação longa: I was eating popcorn when the lights went out. A ação curta fica no passado simples: went out, fell, opened.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “eu estava comendo quando as luzes apagaram”.

compare.us: Em inglês: was/were + -ing para a ação longa e passado simples para a curta.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use was + -ing for an action in progress.
We say I was eat popcorn.
items.why: We say I was eating popcorn.

items.s: When the lights went out is a short action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We use was + -ing for an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say I was eat popcorn. → Falso (We say I was eating popcorn.)
When the lights went out is a short action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
